llm.summary: The skill is mostly a local note-board app, but it contradicts its local-only claims by including user-triggered outbound update and feedback links without clear disclosure.

dimensions.detail: LocalStorage and IndexedDB use is proportionate for persistent notes, images, and uploaded file blobs, but the outbound version check is not proportionate to the local-only privacy promise unless disclosed as an optional network action.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: The artifact is a single HTML app plus documentation, with no executable installer or dependency installation. The packaging command is documented as a manual distribution step.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: The activation wording is broad for generic note-taking, clipboard organization, archiving, and skill-packaging requests. This is a routing-quality concern, not evidence of harmful runtime behavior.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: The app persistently stores notes, drafts, trash, folder metadata, images, and uploaded file blobs in browser storage. This is disclosed and purpose-aligned, though users should understand that local browser data remains until cleared.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

dimensions.detail: The stated purpose is a zero-dependency, local-only text, image, folder, and Word-export board. Those core capabilities match the implementation, but the HTML also fetches a version endpoint on clawhub.ai and opens a Google Forms feedback page, while the documentation says it does not network or upload.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

llm.guidance: Review before installing if you require a strictly offline tool. The note, image, file, trash, and export features are local browser features, but clicking the update control contacts clawhub.ai and clicking feedback opens Google Forms. Avoid storing highly sensitive material unless you are comfortable with browser-local persistence and understand how to clear the app's LocalStorage and IndexedDB data.
llm.findings:
[SDI-1] unexpected: Accepted in part: the fetch to clawhub.ai and external feedback page are present and conflict with repeated local-only/no-network claims, though they appear user-triggered and do not send stored note contents.
[SDI-2] unexpected: Accepted: update checking is not needed for core note capture or Word export and adds network egress to an otherwise local tool.
[SQP-1] expected: Downgraded: the broad description may cause over-invocation, but it does not grant extra runtime authority or show hidden behavior by itself.
[SQP-1] expected: Downgraded: the use-case list is broad, including generic packaging language, but the artifact behavior remains centered on the stated note-board app.
[SQP-2] unexpected: Accepted: the update check destination is not disclosed in the local-only documentation, and users are not clearly told that checking updates contacts clawhub.ai.
